verdict.rationale: Ledgy's own product pages say share awards can be granted "one by one, or in bulk" with contracts created, signed and shared in a few clicks. They also say granting workflows can be automated in bulk, and that historical transaction data can be brought into the cap table with documents attached. These are marketing-level claims only, with no detail on how the bulk upload works. Missing for 10: documentation of the bulk upload mechanism (spreadsheet/CSV template, validation, error handling), explicit confirmation that historical transactions are imported in batch rather than one by one, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can upload or issue securities in bulk — a batch of grants or historical transactions — instead of entering them one at a time

citations.quote: Grant share awards one by one, or in bulk, creating, signing and sharing contracts in just a few clicks.
Automate your granting, document and signature workflows in bulk to make expansion easy.
Bring historical transaction data into your cap table, with documents attached for maximum visibility and accuracy.
